name: University of West Bohemia
summary: Founded in 1991 in Plzeň; one English bachelor's, a four-year double degree in management and digital technology taught in Cheb with a German partner.

handoff.label: Management and Digital Technology: for applicants

ib.text: The faculty's rules ask foreign school-leavers for nostrification or its own assessment (CZK 500); Czech law now accepts the IB Diploma without nostrification, so ask the faculty which applies.

programmes.name: Management and Digital Technology
programmes.about: Business economics joined with robotics, digitalisation and AI in production, taught in English in Cheb and at OTH Amberg-Weiden in Bavaria, with two six-month company internships and two degrees at the end.
programmes.ib: Czech or German at A2 is required (a certificate, or German in your school-leaving exam); English B2, which an IB Diploma taken in English meets.
programmes.selectionNote: Your penultimate-year grade average scores up to 40 (25 to pass), then an online interview in English up to 80; 60 of 120 admits. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The double degree is shared with OTH Amberg-Weiden in Weiden, Bavaria, and includes two 20-week internships at partner companies in Czechia or Germany.
UWB's fee decision for 2026/27 sets no tuition fee for this English bachelor's; the application fee is CZK 750.
Its other English degrees are master's and doctoral; the electrical engineering bachelor's is taught in Czech only.
